subject: SIG questionnaire - checkpoint and accelerated initial pass request
content:
From: Jane Peterson <jane.peterson@finserv-example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finserv-example.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire and evidence timeline (deadline 2026-11-05)

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for partnering with FinServ Capital on the integration review. Attached is our SIG template — were hoping to get a first completed pass by Nov 5 so our security team can start an internal review.

High-level asks:
- Completed SIG spreadsheet (all answers filled).
- Evidence for critical controls (SOC 2 report, network diagram, encryption key management screenshots, IAM policy snippets).
- Point-of-contact for any clarifying questions.

Can you confirm who will be the main owner on your side and whether a weekly checkpoint (30 min) works next Tuesday at 10am PT?

Thanks,
Jane Peterson
Director, Security Operations
FinServ Capital

Attachment: SIG_Template_FinServ.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jane Peterson <jane.peterson@finserv-example.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire and evidence timeline (deadline 2026-11-05)

Hi Jane,

Appreciate the template and the clear deadline. I can be the primary contact for the integration; Marissa will lead evidence collation.

Proposed plan:
- Internal kickoff today: Marissa will map each SIG section to an evidence owner.
- Weekly checkpoint every Tuesday 10am PT for a rolling review (first checkpoint 2026-10-20).
- Deliver a first-pass completed SIG (answers + inline references to artifacts) by EOD 2026-11-03 so you have a 48-hour window before your internal review.

We have the following artifacts ready or in progress: SOC 2 Type II (redacted), network diagram, SRE runbook excerpt, and encryption key management overview. Ill confirm attachments and delivery schedule after our kickoff.

If FinServ needs earlier access to any particular evidence, flag it and well prioritize.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire and evidence timeline (kickoff + owners)

Thanks Ben. Quick owner + ETA matrix from the kickoff this afternoon:

- SIG spreadsheet population: Marissa Cole (owner) - initial answers by 2026-10-27, first-pass by 2026-11-03.
- SOC 2 redacted copy: Monica Patel (owner) - will provide by 2026-10-22 (in progress).
- Network diagram + VPC layout: Stephanie Nguyen (owner) - 2026-10-25.
- KMS/HSM key policy extracts: Stephanie Nguyen - 2026-10-29.
- IAM policy & access review evidence: Marissa & Monica - 2026-11-01.

Blocked items:
- Our audit team is booked week of 10/25 for another customer review; may delay SOC2 extraction if we need a new redaction pass.
- Stephanie needs SCAL access to the network diagram source (ticket opened).

Action items:
- Stephanie: confirm network diagram export format (PNG vs PDF) and provide a stub.
- Monica: upload SOC2 redacted PDF to secure Drive and share link.
- Ben: escalate to solutions engineering if we need faster access to SCAL exports.

Ill maintain an evidence_index.csv as we collect artifacts and share weekly.

Marissa
Product Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_index.csv (planning stub)

---

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire and evidence timeline (status update)

Quick update:
- Network diagram export is ready as a PDF but I need to remove internal IPs and a few customer-specific labels. Im scheduling redaction with infra this week.
- KMS extracts require a short runbook excerpt from SRE; SRE flagged a dependency on the release freeze (10/28-10/30).

Uploading the current evidence_index.csv to the shared project folder now.

If were constrained on the SOC2 redaction, I suggest we provide the redacted SOC2 plus a follow-up secure review session where we can answer questions live. That mitigates the risk of missing the 11/03 first-pass.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_index.csv (v0.3)

---

From: Jane Peterson <jane.peterson@finserv-example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire and evidence timeline (checkpoint and accelerated initial pass)

Ben / team,

Thanks for the clear plan and for surfacing blockers. Were able to be flexible: could you aim to deliver the first completed pass (answers + links to artifacts) by COB Wednesday 2026-11-03 instead of Nov 5? That would let our security review start earlier and surface any critical follow-ups.

We can also accept provisional artifacts (e.g., redacted SOC2 + scheduled redaction notes) as long as theres a named owner and ETA for the final redaction.

Ive added a HubSpot task for our security review and shared the spreadsheet back with a few clarifying comments. Link below.

HubSpot Task: https://app.hubspot.com/rep/1234567/task/TSK-9876
SIG spreadsheet received: SIG_Template_FinServ.xlsx

Confirming weekly checkpoint on Tuesday 10am PT starting 2026-11-03 (30 min). Please reply with confirmation that well deliver the initial pass by COB 11/03 and that Monica is the SOC2 point of contact.

Best regards,
Jane Peterson
Director, Security Operations
FinServ Capital

Attachment: SIG_Template_FinServ.xlsx (annotated comments)

---

Notes:
- Internal thread updated to include evidence_index.csv and links to the private Drive (access controlled).
- Next steps: Ben to confirm escalation path if redaction/SCAL access delays block Monica/Stephanie.
- Meeting: Weekly checkpoint Tuesdays 10:00-10:30 PT (calendar invite to be sent).
